newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unveils PowerPC platform reference.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unveils PowerPC platform reference.

text.p: Motorola Inc's microprocessor division on Monday unveiled Yellowknife, a reference for building computers based on the PowerPC platform.
The Yellowknife design is for key customers to utilize in manufacturing PowerPC-based computer equipment. It can run with Windows NT, Mac OS and other operating sytems.
Motorola unveiled the design guide at the COMDEX computer trade show held this week in Las Vegas.
Motorola said UMAX Computer Corp, a vendor of Macintosh clones, intended to use the reference design to build the company's first PowerPC platform systems, expected in early 1997.
